remarks: Light, bright, totally updated and recently painted end unit townhouse with new dishwasher, stove, washer, drier, bathroom mirrors. Newer carpeting throughout. Lots of closet space. Large walk in storage room on lower level. Newer blinds in bedrooms. Great bright family room (or guest bedroom) with closet. Minutes to schools, shopping, train. Heating gas hot air and electric, and central a/c. 2 Reserved parking spaces.  Well maintained small complex. Must have confirmed appointment. Tenant in place until April 30, 2026
